title: Pokemon TCG Deluxe Bomb Stellar Crown 134/142 Ace Spec Ultra Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Deluxe Bomb 134/142 Ace Spec Stellar Crown Pokemon Card is a highly sought-after collectible card from the Pokémon TCG. This Ultra Rare card features the character Ace and belongs to the Stellar Crown set. With its English language text and Pokémon Tool card type, it is a valuable addition to any collector's deck. Known by its card name, Deluxe Bomb, this card is sure to be a standout piece in any competitive gameplay.
